name: brimpa
description: Brimpa's reusable Agent Skills (security review, LLM app security, DPDP legal compliance, UI/UX, web design, luxury web design, SEO/GEO audit, launch marketing, brand identity, launch video, web scraping, reverse engineering, knowledge base) plus the upstream skill repos they were distilled from, installable as-is.

plugins.name: brimpa-skills
plugins.description: All thirteen Brimpa skills in one plugin. Install this unless you want to cherry-pick with `npx skills add`.

plugins.name: threejs-skills
plugins.description: Upstream, installed as-is: thirteen three.js r186 API skills (fundamentals, geometry, materials, lighting, textures, animation, loaders, shaders, post-processing, interaction, performance, React Three Fiber, asset pipeline). MIT.

plugins.name: brag
plugins.description: Upstream, installed as-is: /brag and /brag-slim turn the current project into a short launch video with music, motion and share copy (HyperFrames-based; brag-slim needs no HyperFrames). MIT.

plugins.name: claude-seo
plugins.description: Upstream, installed as-is: the full claude-seo suite that seo-geo-audit was distilled from. MIT.

plugins.name: taste-skill
plugins.description: Upstream, installed as-is: taste-skill design directions and inspector scripts. MIT.

plugins.name: impeccable
plugins.description: Upstream, installed as-is: impeccable design commands (needs its CLI for live and detector features). Apache-2.0.

plugins.name: ui-ux-pro-max
plugins.description: Upstream, installed as-is: UI UX Pro Max design-system generator, styles, brand and slides skills. MIT.

plugins.name: security-audit-skill
plugins.description: Upstream, installed as-is: Cloudflare's security-audit skill with its full-audit mode and validators. MIT.

plugins.name: strix
plugins.description: Upstream, installed as-is: Strix skills (they drive the Strix CLI / cloud). Apache-2.0.

plugins.name: opendirectory-gtm-skills
plugins.description: Upstream, installed as-is: 65 GTM and marketing skills from OpenDirectory. MIT.
